en: A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a picturesque canal scene in Bruges, Belgium. On the right is a large, ornate Gothic-style building with pointed towers and elaborate decorations, likely the Palais du Franc. The left side of the image shows a tree-lined street with two children standing near the water’s edge. Two swans are swimming in the canal. In the background, a small stone bridge crosses the water. The postcard includes French text at the top and along the left margin.
